title: Octopus dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='octo' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff7ac8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c93a92'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- wavy arms -->
  <path d='M30 55 Q20 65 26 75 Q32 83 24 90' stroke='#ff5fb8' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M38 60 Q30 72 38 80 Q46 87 38 94' stroke='#ff7ac8' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 62 Q48 74 56 80 Q64 86 58 93' stroke='#ff9ad6' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 60 Q70 72 62 80 Q54 87 62 94' stroke='#ff7ac8' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 55 Q80 65 74 75 Q68 83 76 90' stroke='#ff5fb8' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- side arms raised for dancing -->
  <path d='M22 45 Q10 38 6 28' stroke='#ff5fb8' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M78 45 Q90 38 94 28' stroke='#ff5fb8' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head/body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='28' ry='26' fill='url(#octo)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='18' ry='12' fill='#ffa8de' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='36' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#fff6fb'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='36' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#fff6fb'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='37' r='3.2' fill='#3a2450'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='37' r='3.2' fill='#3a2450'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- happy mouth -->
  <path d='M44 48 Q50 55 56 48' stroke='#7a1f5c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='45' r='4' fill='#ff4fa8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='45' r='4' fill='#ff4fa8' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
